# app-project

The project file the Forge GUI and forge share: its document and the command line it stands for. Internal; compiled into the programs.

A app library, internal to the repository.

- **Uses:** `ac3`
- **Used by:** `forge`
- **CI lanes:** windows, linux, macos

## Build and test

```sh
cmake --preset config-linux-gcc && cmake --build --preset build-linux-gcc
ctest --preset test-linux-gcc -L app-project
```

All the projects are in the one CMake build; `ctest -L` runs this project's tests alone.
